description: This source file defines the DebugLogStrategy class, which inherits from AbstractLogStrategy and implements logging behavior using a debug mode. It provides methods to log messages and data via a logger interface.

classes.name: DebugLogStrategy
classes.description: A class providing debug logging implementation by overriding Execute methods from AbstractLogStrategy.

methods.name: DebugLogStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the logger in the debug log strategy.

methods.name: Execute (LogModel log)
methods.description: Logs the message contained in the LogModel object at debug level.

methods.description: Logs a combined message and data string at debug level.
